youtube.baslik: What is the most common cause of dizziness in children? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The most common causes of dizziness in children are migraine-related conditions; benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) and Meniere's disease, common in adults, are less frequent in children. In 2021 the Barany Society and the International Headache Society defined vestibular migraine of childhood (at least five attacks) and recurrent vertigo of childhood (at least three attacks, without migraine history or features) for those under 18; the physician makes the diagnosis.
